notes.title: 13/04/2025-Update
notes.content:
13/04/2025 Update Notes:

(We recommend starting the game from scratch by creating a new character in each update for a few months as we are just starting to build the game.)

1- We continued decorating the new level (Mine Level 2).
2- We continued decorating the new sub-level (Mine Level 2-Iron Ore). 
3- We fixed some minor bugs.
4- For the time being, some intractable game elements are not deleted once you play. This means that you will be dealing with the same enemy and destroying the same object, say a barrel, each time you load the game. This makes the game very easy to play now, but we will change it in the future, and once you play the game, the level will be completely free of any intractable game elements.
5- We are enlarging the Town and putting many new things into it. The town will be much better soon.
6- We are working on removing the unnecessary appearances of health bars here and there. It is a bit of a thorny process, so please bear with us. 
7- Mine Level 3 will be available soon.
8- We added several new enemies. We will be adding more and optimizing them soon.
9- There might be annoying bugs. We will solve them soon. We know that when the character is stuck, it is highly frustrating and annoying. It is not entirely our fault. If one appears, we will solve it in collaboration with some experts of the game engine we use. Thank you for your patience.
10- We changed our main character.
11- We added two more main characters (Necromancher and Sorcerer) so that you can play the game with different characters with different attributes and abilities, which will be improved soon.
12- We enhanced some UI menu elements.
13- You might experience problems if you try to create a character again and again on the same page. Character creation will be more convenient soon.

2- We added a new sub-level (Mine Level 2-Iron Ore). We will start decorating it soon.
3- We fixed some minor bugs.
4- For the time being, some intractable game elements are not deleted once you play. This means that you will be dealing with the same enemy and destroying the same object, say a barrel, each time you load the game. 5- We are enlarging the Town and putting many new things into it.
6- We are working on removing the unnecessary appearances of health bars here and there. It is a bit of a thorny process, so please bear with us. 
7- Mine Level 3 will be available soon.
8- There might be annoying bugs. We will solve them soon. Thank you for your patience.
